UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the  following  O R D E R 1.

Being aggrieved by the rejection of the anticipatory bail petition by the impugned order of the High Court of Punjab & Haryana at Chandigarh with respect to the offences registered under Sections 406, 420, 467, 471 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 in CRM-M No.41202/2025,
the present special leave petition has been filed.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In furtherance of the order dated 29.08.2025, the petitioner has joined the investigation twice which is not disputed by the learned counsel representing the respondent-State.
2. It is submitted by him that the relevant documents are not supplied.
In response Mr. Siddharth Aggarwal, learned senior counsel submits that the prosecution is asking for purchase orders which may be in possession of the complainant.
It is, further, submitted that whatever documents are in his possession are being handed over to the counsel representing the respondent-State during the course of hearing.

3. Having considered the submissions and in the facts of the case, documents which are available with the petitioner have been handed over and he has joined the investigation and also cooperating in the investigation.
As such, at this stage, it is not necessary to send him for custodial interrogation.
In case the respondent is in need of other documents, it be supplied, otherwise, explanation for the same be furnished by the petitioner.

4. In view of above, we are inclined to confirm the order of interim protection dated 29.08.2025 and without expressing any opinion on merits, we deem it appropriate to release the petitioner in the event of his arrest.

We acknowledge the same and not embarking upon further since this relates to internal functioning of the Honble Judges of the High Court, however left the recourse open to the Chief Justice of High Court to look into and take necessary measures with intent to curb such issues.

Accordingly and in view of the foregoing, the present special leave petition is allowed and is disposed of with the following directions :
a.

The petitioner, in the event of his arrest in connection with FIR No.155/2025 dated 06.05.2025 registered with Police Station Dabua, Faridaba, Haryana, shall be released on bail on furnishing suitable bail bonds and sureties for the satisfaction of the arresting officer;
b.

The Registrar General of the High Court shall place the orders and all the relevant material before the Chief Justice to take recourse in the matter, to avoid delay in passing and uploading the orders in the bail petition.
6. Pending applications, if any, shall stand disposed of.
( GULSHAN KUMAR ARORA) (NAND KISHOR)
